topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I just found out someone got my artwork tattooed on their skin! I mean, wow, talk about taking a piece of you with them. It’s flattering, really. I’ve been getting messages from people tagging me in pictures of it. It’s like my creation has a new life now, etched permanently as part of someone’s story. It makes me think about how art travels, connects, and becomes a part of people’s identities. It’s a wonderful sensation, seeing your work live on in such a profound and personal way. I can’t wait to see what adventures this tattoo goes on with its new guardian.
